terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.lede: This page sets out the conditions for using HYPERNOVA. By using this site you confirm that you have read and accept the terms below. The Chinese version governs; this English version is provided for convenience.
sections: 1. What this site is
HYPERNOVA is independently developed and operated by an individual. It is provided free of charge, has no account system, and accepts no payment of any kind.

The site is a calculation tool: you enter trade parameters, your browser performs the arithmetic locally, and the result is displayed. The site connects to no exchange account. It cannot and will not place or cancel orders, move funds, or access your wallet.
The site is not a broker, exchange, investment adviser or licensed financial institution of any kind, and has not been reviewed, approved or registered by any regulator in any jurisdiction.
2. Not investment advice
Every figure this site produces is a theoretical estimate derived from the parameters you enter, provided for research and reference only.

These figures do not constitute investment advice, an offer, a solicitation, or any promise or guarantee as to trading outcomes. Whether to trade, how to trade, and how much risk to take are entirely your own decisions, and the consequences are yours.

Trading crypto derivatives carries a high degree of risk and may result in the total loss of capital. Under extreme market conditions, actual outcomes may diverge materially from the estimates shown here.
3. Provided as is, without warranty

The site is provided on an "as is" and "as available" basis, without warranty of any kind, express or implied, including but not limited to merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, accuracy, completeness, availability, or uninterrupted operation.

The site may contain calculation errors, stale data, display faults or functional defects. You should verify any result independently before relying on it, and defer to the figures shown by the exchange you actually trade on.
Features may be changed, suspended or discontinued at any time without notice.
4. Third-party data
The site requests contract parameters (maximum leverage and size precision) from Hyperliquid's public API, in order to fill in the maintenance margin rate and cap the leverage slider.

That data is supplied by a third party. The site cannot guarantee its accuracy, timeliness or continued availability. If the API changes, fails or becomes unreachable, the site falls back to manual entry and calculation is unaffected.

The maintenance margin rate is derived as 1 ÷ (2 × maximum leverage). Note that exchanges apply tiered margin to large positions, and that the liquidation price is also affected by funding costs, realised P/L and other open positions. These factors are not modelled here.
5. Relationship with third parties
HYPERNOVA is an independent third-party tool with no affiliation, partnership, sponsorship or endorsement relationship with Hyperliquid Labs or its affiliates.

References to Hyperliquid serve only to identify the contract rules and data source this tool relies on, and constitute nominative use. Hyperliquid and any other names or marks mentioned are trademarks of their respective owners.
6. Limitation of liability

To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, the operator of this site shall not be liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, special, punitive or consequential loss arising from the use of, or inability to use, this site, including but not limited to trading losses, lost profits, loss of data or loss of goodwill.
This limitation applies under any theory of liability, whether or not the operator has been advised of the possibility of such loss.
7. Acceptable use

You may not use this site for unlawful activity, attempt to interfere with its operation or that of the services it depends on, or issue automated bulk requests to this site or, through it, to third-party APIs.

The source code is published on GitHub. You may read it, learn from it and deploy it yourself, but you may not use the site's name or marks in any way that would lead others to believe it is an official product or affiliated with a third party.
8. Changes to these terms

These terms may be updated from time to time. An updated version takes effect on publication, and the date at the top of this page is revised accordingly. Continued use of the site constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.
9. Contact

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.lede: This page explains what HYPERNOVA collects, what it does not, and where data is held. The short answer: the site collects no personal information, and the trade parameters you enter never leave your device.
sections: 1. What the site does not collect
There is no account system. No registration, no sign-in, and no wallet connection is required.
The site sets no cookies and loads no third-party analytics, advertising or tracking scripts.

The account size, entry price, stop price, target price, leverage and every other parameter you enter — together with every record in the trade journal — are never uploaded to any server, including this site's own. All computation happens in your browser.
2. Data stored on your device
So that you need not re-enter everything on your next visit, the site stores a small amount of data in your browser's localStorage. It stays on your device and the site cannot read it remotely:
· hn_calc_prefs — frequently used calculator inputs (account size, risk rate, leverage, fee rate, margin mode)
· hn_trades — all trade journal records
· hn_jprefs — the symbol and direction last used in the journal form
· hn_hl_meta_v1 — cached Hyperliquid contract parameters, valid for 24 hours
Clearing your browser data removes all of the above. The site also provides a "Clear all" button for the journal and an "Export" function that writes your records to a file you keep yourself.
3. The one outbound request
The site sends a single request to Hyperliquid's public API to retrieve the contract list (maximum leverage and size precision for each contract):
POST https://api.hyperliquid.xyz/info  with body {"type":"meta"}

The request contains none of your input; it is a fixed query. The response is cached in your browser for 24 hours. If the request fails, the site falls back silently to manual entry and functionality is unaffected.
As with any network request, Hyperliquid's servers will observe your IP address in the process. That is inherent to network communication and cannot be avoided on your behalf.
4. Hosting logs

The site is hosted on Cloudflare. As with every website, the host's servers record standard access logs, typically including IP address, browser identifier, timestamp and the path requested, for security and troubleshooting purposes.
That data is handled by Cloudflare under its own policies. The site's operator does not actively read, analyse or retain those logs, and builds no user profiles from them.
5. Sharing and cross-border transfer
The site collects no personal data, so there is no sale, sharing or cross-border transfer of personal data to speak of.
No information about you will be provided to third parties for any commercial purpose — because the site does not hold any.
6. Children
The site is not directed at minors and does not knowingly collect information from them.
7. Changes to this policy
This policy may be updated as features change. Should any future feature introduce an outbound request or data collection, this page will be revised and the date at the top updated accordingly.
8. Contact
Questions about this policy may be sent to contact@hypernova.vip.
